EnvSched schedules agent RL rollouts by environment, not just task: it predicts reward variance and spreads batches across underobserved envs. 40 steps beat random selection's 120 on agent benchmarks. Scheduling is an RL lever, not bookkeeping. https://t.co/AylRvoI6oO https://t.co/g1zSCvCzGA

We generated 458,000 RL environments to train an agent on stateful, multi-step on-device tasks. We share in our preprint how we decided along which axes to enlargen our RL env corpus, via data composition scaling laws.

Reward a model for covering rubric items and it learns to say everything.

Rubric RL usually scores recall, so extra or wrong sentences cost nothing. On RubricHub-Medical the RL model beat its own base only 10.6% of the time. Add a precision term: 68%.
